topic: How GPS knows where you are

request.notes: A Kurzgesagt-like explainer in the flat-cosmos style: the night field, Earth, satellites on their orbits. Show the mechanism running: each satellite broadcasting where it is and the exact time, the signal travelling to a phone, distance worked out from the travel time, circles and spheres intersecting to pin one point, a fourth satellite fixing the phone's cheap clock, and the satellites' own clocks running at a different rate in orbit (speed and gravity) and the correction that keeps a position from drifting. Real numbers only where the knowledge sheet grounds them. People only if the style has a designed character kit; otherwise none.
